comments_text: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that the sequence of this peptide shows 75% similarity to CE-MA hybrid. A hybrid of melittin, cecropin A1 and magainin 2. Active against Gram+ S. aureus CMCC26003 or MRSA (MIC 0.25-4 ug/mL), B. subtilis DB430 (MIC 2 ug/mL), S. epidermidis (MIC 0.5-8 ug/ml), B. pumilus CMCC63202 (MIC 0.5 ug/mL), M. luteus CMCC28001 (MIC 2 ug/mL), Gram- E. coli ATCC8099 (MIC 0.5 ug/mL), K. pneumoniae CMCC46117 or clinical (MIC 0.5-4 ug/mL), S. paratyphi B CMCC50094 (MIC 2 ug/mL), P. aeruginosa CMCC10104 (MIC 1-8 ug/mL). Animal model:mouse: K11 also showed efficacy in wound healing ( Rishi et al., 2018). Updated 7/2021
